resources.string: Just a moment.\nYour run starts as soon as your location is found.
You\'ll be marked ready as soon as your location is found.
A mock location app is on
Turn off the mock location app in developer options to use real GPS.
Turn on Wi-Fi or mobile data, or move somewhere with a view of the sky.
Allow precise location to run together. Turn on “Use precise location” in Settings › Permissions › Location.
